en.t: Domitian became Emperor of the Roman Empire upon the death of his brother Titus
en.s: The Roman Empire was a state that dominated the Mediterranean and much of Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa during the classical period. The Roman Republic had previously conquered most of these territories, which later came under permanent single-person rule following Octavian's rise to power and the establishment of the Augustan Principate in 27 BC. By the late 3rd century AD, the empire had been divided many times.

zh.t: 多米提安在其兄提图斯去世后成为罗马皇帝
zh.s: 罗马帝国是古典时代统治地中海沿岸及欧洲、西亚和北非广大地区的国家。此前，罗马共和国已经征服了其中大部分领土。屋大维崛起并于公元前27年建立奥古斯都元首制后，这些领土进入长期的单人统治时期。到公元3世纪晚期，帝国已经历多次分裂。

en.s: The Battle of Islandbridge, also called the Battle of Áth Cliath, took place on 14 September 919 between a coalition of native Irish, led by Niall Glúndub, overking of the Northern Uí Néill and High King of Ireland, and the Dublin-based Vikings of the Uí Ímair, led by Sitric Cáech. It was one in a series of battles initiated by the native Irish to attempt to drive the Vikings of the Uí Ímair from Ireland. The battle was a decisive victory for Sitric Cáech and the Uí Ímair, with Niall Glúndub and five other Irish kings falling in the battle.

zh.s: 岛桥战役又称阿斯克利亚斯战役，于919年9月14日爆发。交战一方是由北乌伊尼尔国王兼爱尔兰最高王尼尔·格伦杜布率领的爱尔兰本土诸势力联盟，另一方是由锡特里克·凯赫率领、以都柏林为据点的乌伊伊迈尔维京人。爱尔兰人此前发动了一系列战役，试图将乌伊伊迈尔维京人赶出爱尔兰。此役以锡特里克·凯赫和乌伊伊迈尔一方决定性胜利告终，尼尔·格伦杜布和另外五位爱尔兰国王阵亡。

en.s: In the Battle of Sarmin (or Battle of Tell Danith) on September 14, 1115, Prince Roger of Salerno's Crusader army surprised and routed the Seljuk Turkish army of Bursuq bin Bursuq of Hamadan.

zh.s: 萨尔敏战役又称泰勒达尼思战役，于1115年9月14日爆发。萨勒诺的罗杰亲王率领的十字军出其不意地击溃了布尔苏克·本·布尔苏克统率的塞尔柱突厥军队。

en.s: In the Rout of Winchester (14 September 1141) the army of imprisoned King Stephen of England, led by his wife, Queen Matilda, Stephen's brother Bishop Henry of Winchester, and William of Ypres, faced the army of Stephen's cousin Empress Matilda, whose forces were commanded by her half-brother Earl Robert of Gloucester. After Empress Matilda's army besieged a castle on the edge of Winchester, Queen Matilda's army arrived and blockaded the Angevin army within the city.

zh.s: 1141年9月14日，英格兰被俘国王斯蒂芬的军队与其表妹、玛蒂尔达皇后的军队在温彻斯特交战。斯蒂芬的妻子玛蒂尔达王后、弟弟温彻斯特主教亨利和威廉·德伊普尔斯率领斯蒂芬一方的军队；皇后玛蒂尔达的军队则由她同母异父的弟弟、格洛斯特伯爵罗伯特指挥。皇后的军队围攻温彻斯特城边的一座城堡后，玛蒂尔达王后的军队赶到，并把安茹军队围困在城内。

en.s: The Battle of Ishibashiyama (石橋山の戦い Ishibashiyama no tatakai) was the first in which Minamoto Yoritomo, who was to become shogun less than a decade later, was commander of the Minamoto forces. The battle was fought on September 14, 1180 in the southwest of present-day Odawara, Kanagawa Prefecture near Yoritomo's headquarters at Kamakura.

zh.s: 石桥山之战（石橋山の戦い，Ishibashiyama no tatakai）是源赖朝首次担任源氏军队指挥官的一场战役。不到十年后，他将成为幕府将军。战斗于1180年9月14日在今神奈川县小田原市西南部爆发，靠近赖朝设在镰仓的总部。

en.s: The Battle of Homildon Hill was a conflict between English and Scottish armies on 14 September 1402 in Northumberland, England. The battle was recounted in Shakespeare’s Henry IV, part 1. Although Humbleton Hill is the modern name of the site, over the centuries it has been variously named Homildon, Hameldun, Holmedon, and Homilheugh.

zh.s: 霍米尔登山战役于1402年9月14日在英格兰诺森伯兰郡爆发，交战双方是英格兰和苏格兰军队。莎士比亚在《亨利四世（上篇）》中描写了这场战役。战场如今称为亨布尔顿山，但几个世纪以来也有霍米尔登、哈梅尔登、霍尔梅登和霍米尔休等不同名称。

en.s: The siege of Trebizond was the successful siege of the city of Trebizond, capital of the Empire of Trebizond, by the Ottomans under Sultan Mehmed II, which ended on 15 August 1461. The siege culminated a lengthy campaign on the Ottoman side, which involved coordinated but independent manoeuvres by a large army and navy.

zh.s: 奥斯曼帝国苏丹穆罕默德二世率军围攻特拉比松帝国首都特拉比松城，并于1461年8月15日成功攻陷。围城战是奥斯曼方面一场长期战役的高潮，奥斯曼大军和海军协同但分别机动。

en.s: The Battle of Marignano, (or bataille de Marignan in French) which took place on 13–14 September 1515, near the town now called Melegnano, 16 km southeast of Milan, was the last major engagement of the War of the League of Cambrai. It pitted the French army, led by Francis I, newly crowned King of France, against the Old Swiss Confederacy.

zh.s: 马里尼亚诺战役也称法语 bataille de Marignan，发生于1515年9月13日至14日，地点在如今名为梅莱尼亚诺的城镇附近，位于米兰东南16公里处。这是康布雷同盟战争中的最后一场重大战役。法军由刚加冕为法国国王的弗朗索瓦一世率领，对手是旧瑞士邦联。

en.s: The Battle of Doire Leathan took place on 14 September 1590 at Doire Leathan (English: Derrylahan), a townland and hamlet located between Kilcar and Carrick in south-western County Donegal in Ulster, Ireland. Derrylahan is on the eastern shores of Teelin Bay, being just across from the village of Teelin. The battle was part of the ongoing succession dispute for the leadership of the Gaelic lordship of O'Donnell.

zh.s: 多伊尔·莱森战役于1590年9月14日在爱尔兰阿尔斯特多尼戈尔郡西南部的多伊尔·莱森爆发。多伊尔·莱森（英语：Derrylahan）是位于基尔卡和卡里克之间的一处乡镇和小村庄，坐落在蒂林湾东岸，隔海湾与蒂林村相望。此战是持续进行的盖尔领主奥唐奈家族继承权争端的一部分。

en.s: The Capture of Oppenheim or the Spanish capture of Oppenheim took place on 14 September 1620, at Oppenheim, Electorate of the Palatinate, between the Spanish army commanded by Don Ambrosio Spinola, Marquis of the Balbases, against the forces of the Electoral Palatinate led by Joachim Ernst, Margrave of Brandenburg-Ansbach, during the Palatinate campaign, in the context of the Thirty Years' War. The Spanish troops under Spinola, with a great maneuver of distraction over Worms, deceived the Protestant army of Joachim Ernst, and captured the important town of Oppenheim without too much difficulty, causing a severe blow to the Protestant forces.

zh.s: 奥本海姆攻占战也称西班牙攻占奥本海姆，于1620年9月14日在普法尔茨选侯国的奥本海姆爆发，是三十年战争期间普法尔茨战役的一部分。安布罗西奥·斯皮诺拉侯爵率领西班牙军队，对阵约阿希姆·恩斯特统率的普法尔茨选侯国军队。斯皮诺拉以沃尔姆斯方向的佯动迷惑新教军队，随后轻易攻占奥本海姆这座重要城镇，给新教军队造成沉重打击。

en.s: From 6 July to 14 September 1655, the Zaporozhian–Don Cossacks blockaded the Kerch Strait to delay Crimean support for Poland-Lithuania.

en.t: Bishop Gore School, one of the oldest schools in Wales, is founded
en.s: The Bishop Gore School (Welsh: Ysgol Esgob Gore) is a secondary school in Swansea in Wales, founded on 14 September 1682 by Hugh Gore (1613–1691), Bishop of Waterford and Lismore. It is situated in Sketty, close to Singleton Park and Swansea University. In December 2013 the school was ranked in the second highest of five bands by the Welsh Government, based on performance in exams, value added performance, disadvantaged pupils' performance, and attendance.

zh.t: 戈尔主教学校于1682年创立
zh.s: 戈尔主教学校（威尔士语：Ysgol Esgob Gore）是位于威尔士斯旺西的一所中学，由休·戈尔（1613—1691）于1682年9月14日创立。休·戈尔当时是沃特福德和利斯莫尔主教。学校位于斯凯蒂，靠近辛格尔顿公园和斯旺西大学。2013年12月，威尔士政府根据考试成绩、增值表现、弱势学生成绩和出勤率对学校评级；该校在五个等级中获第二高等级。

en.s: The Battle of Kalamata took place on 14 September 1685 between the expeditionary army of the Republic of Venice in the Morea, led by Hannibal von Degenfeld, and the forces of the Ottoman Empire, led by the Kapudan Pasha. The battle ended in a Venetian victory, which allowed the Venetians to complete the conquest of the Mani Peninsula, solidifying their foothold in the southern Morea.

zh.s: 卡拉马塔战役于1685年9月14日爆发。威尼斯共和国派往摩里亚的远征军由汉尼拔·冯·德根费尔德率领，对阵由卡普丹帕夏统率的奥斯曼帝国军队。威尼斯军获胜后完成了对马尼半岛的征服，巩固了其在摩里亚南部的据点。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Duquesne was a British assault on the eponymous French fort (later the site of Pittsburgh) that was repulsed with heavy losses on 14 September 1758, during the French and Indian War. The attack on Fort Duquesne was part of a large-scale British expedition with 6,000 troops led by General John Forbes to drive the French out of the contested Ohio Country (the upper Ohio River Valley) and clear the way for an invasion of Canada. Forbes ordered Major James Grant of the 1st Highland Regiment to reconnoiter the area with 850 men.

zh.s: 杜肯堡战役是英国军队于1758年9月14日在法国和印第安人战争期间对法国杜肯堡发动的一次进攻，遭到守军击退，英军损失惨重。约翰·福布斯将军率领6000人的英军远征队，意在将法国人赶出争议中的俄亥俄地区（俄亥俄河上游流域），为入侵加拿大扫清道路。福布斯命令第一高地团的詹姆斯·格兰特少校率850人侦察该地区。杜肯堡后来成为匹兹堡所在地。

en.s: The Battle of Devil's Hole, known to the Anglo-Americans as the Devil's Hole Massacre, was fought near Niagara Gorge in present-day New York state on September 14, 1763, between a detachment of the British 80th Regiment of Light Armed Foot and about 300 Seneca warriors during Pontiac's Rebellion (1763–1766). The Seneca warriors killed 81 British soldiers and wounded 8 before the British managed to retreat.

zh.s: 魔鬼洞战役也称英美方面所说的“魔鬼洞大屠杀”，于1763年9月14日在今纽约州尼亚加拉峡谷附近爆发。交战双方是英国第80轻装步兵团的一支分遣队和约300名塞内卡战士，属于庞蒂亚克起义（1763—1766年）的一部分。塞内卡战士杀死81名英国士兵、打伤8人，随后英军才得以撤退。

en.s: The Storming of Hirsovo (Hirsova) was a military operation carried out by Ottoman troops on 14 September (O.S. 3 September) 1773 during the Russo-Turkish War (1768–1774). The Ottoman Grand Vizier Muhsinzade Mehmed Pasha decided to storm the Hirsovo fortress occupied by Russian troops of Alexander Suvorov to facilitate the seizure of Giurgiu.

zh.s: 希尔索瓦要塞突袭是奥斯曼军队于1773年9月14日（儒略历9月3日）发动的一次军事行动，发生在1768—1774年俄土战争期间。奥斯曼大维齐尔穆赫辛扎德·穆罕默德帕夏决定攻占由亚历山大·苏沃洛夫率领的俄军驻守的希尔索瓦要塞，以便夺取久尔久。

en.s: The action of 14 September 1779 was a minor naval engagement that occurred on 14 September 1779, off the Azores between the Royal Navy frigate HMS Pearl under the command of George Montagu and the Spanish Navy frigate Santa Mónica under the command of Miguel de Nunes, with Pearl capturing Santa Mónica after a brief engagement.

zh.s: 1779年9月14日，亚速尔群岛附近发生一场小规模海战。乔治·蒙塔古指挥的英国皇家海军“珍珠”号护卫舰与米格尔·德·努内斯指挥的西班牙海军“圣莫妮卡”号护卫舰交战。短暂交火后，“珍珠”号俘获了“圣莫妮卡”号。

en.s: The Battle of Pirmasens (14 September 1793) saw a French Republican corps led by Jean René Moreaux attack a Kingdom of Prussia force led by Charles William Ferdinand, Duke of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel. From prepared positions, the Prussians caught the French in a deadly crossfire, forcing them to withdraw. The clash happened during the War of the First Coalition, part of a larger conflict known as the French Revolutionary Wars. In 1793 Pirmasens was part of the Bavarian Palatinate but today the city is in the state of Rhineland-Palatinate in Germany, 34.4 kilometres (21 mi) south of Kaiserslautern.

zh.s: 皮尔马森斯战役于1793年9月14日爆发。让·勒内·莫罗率领的法兰西共和军团进攻不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔公爵卡尔·威廉·斐迪南指挥的普鲁士军队。普军占据预设阵地，以猛烈交叉火力击退法军，迫使其撤退。此役发生在第一次反法同盟战争期间，该战争属于法国大革命战争的一部分。1793年皮尔马森斯属于巴伐利亚普法尔茨，如今则是德国莱茵兰-普法尔茨州的一座城市，位于凯泽斯劳滕以南34.4公里（21英里）。

en.s: The Battle of Oravais (occasionally Orawais; Finnish: Oravaisten taistelu; Swedish: Slaget vid Oravais) from September 14 until September 15 was one of the decisive battles in the Finnish War, fought from 1808 to 1809 between Sweden and the Russian Empire as part of the wider Napoleonic Wars. Taking place in modern-day Vörå in western Finland, it is sometimes regarded as the turning point of the Finnish War: the last chance for Sweden to turn the war to her advantage.
en.n: Finnish War: Russians defeat the Swedes at the Battle of Oravais.

zh.s: 奥拉瓦伊斯战役也称奥拉瓦伊斯战斗，发生于9月14日至15日，是1808—1809年芬兰战争中的一场关键战役。芬兰战争是瑞典与俄罗斯帝国之间冲突的一部分，也属于更广泛的拿破仑战争。战斗地点在今天芬兰西部的韦勒。它有时被视为芬兰战争的转折点，也是瑞典最后一次有机会扭转战局。
zh.n: 芬兰战争：俄军在奥拉瓦伊斯战役中击败瑞典军队。

en.s: In the Battle of La Bisbal on 14 September 1810 a Spanish division led by Henry O'Donnell (also known as Enrique José O'Donnell) and supported by an Anglo-Spanish naval squadron led by Francis William Fane and Charles William Doyle surprised an Imperial French brigade commanded by François Xavier de Schwarz. The Imperial troops were from the Confederation of the Rhine, a collection of small German states that were allied to Napoleon. Part of a division led by Marie François Rouyer, Schwarz's brigade was almost completely wiped out, most of its soldiers being taken prisoner along with its commander.

zh.s: 1810年9月14日，亨利·奥唐奈（又名恩里克·何塞·奥唐奈）率领西班牙师，在弗朗西斯·威廉·费恩和查尔斯·威廉·多伊尔指挥的英西海军中队支援下，突袭了弗朗索瓦·泽维尔·德·施瓦茨指挥的法兰西帝国军旅。该法军旅由莱茵邦联部队组成，莱茵邦联是支持拿破仑的多个德意志小邦联盟。施瓦茨的部队隶属玛丽·弗朗索瓦·鲁耶的师，几乎全军覆没；大多数士兵和施瓦茨本人都被俘。

en.s: During the French occupation of Moscow, a fire persisted from 14 to 18 September 1812 and all but destroyed the city. The Russian troops and most of the remaining civilians had abandoned the city on 14 September 1812 just ahead of French Emperor Napoleon's troops entering the city after the Battle of Borodino.

en.s: The Battle of Baltimore took place between British and American forces on September 12–14, 1814, during the War of 1812. Defending American forces repulsed sea and land invasions off the busy major port city of Baltimore, Maryland, by British forces preventing the United States' third largest city at the time from falling to British forces and ending the British Chesapeake campaign.
en.n: Battle of Baltimore: The poem Defence of Fort McHenry is written by Francis Scott Key. The poem is later used as the lyrics of The Star-Spangled Banner.

zh.s: 巴尔的摩战役发生于1814年9月12日至14日，是1812年战争的一部分。英国军队从海上和陆路进攻马里兰州巴尔的摩这一重要港口城市，守城的美国军队击退了进攻，阻止这座当时美国第三大城市落入英军之手，也结束了英国在切萨皮克地区的军事行动。
zh.n: 巴尔的摩战役期间，弗朗西斯·斯科特·基创作了诗歌《保卫麦克亨利堡》（Defence of Fort McHenry）。这首诗后来成为美国国歌《星条旗》（The Star-Spangled Banner）的歌词。

en.s: The 1829 Maine gubernatorial election took place on September 14, 1829. Incumbent Democratic-Republican Governor Enoch Lincoln did not run for re-election. National Republican candidate Jonathan G. Hunton defeated Democratic candidate Samuel E. Smith in an extremely close election. Hunton defeated Smith by just 324 votes, one of the narrowest margins in Maine gubernatorial history.

zh.s: 1829年缅因州州长选举于9月14日举行。民主共和党籍现任州长伊诺克·林肯没有竞选连任。国家共和党候选人乔纳森·G·亨顿以极微弱优势击败民主党候选人塞缪尔·E·史密斯，仅领先324票，是缅因州州长选举史上差距最小的选举之一。

en.s: The Treaty of Adrianople (also called the Treaty of Edirne) concluded the Russo-Turkish War of 1828–29, between Imperial Russia and the Ottoman Empire. The terms favored Russia, which gained access to the mouths of the Danube and new territory on the Black Sea. The treaty opened the Dardanelles to all commercial vessels, granted autonomy to Serbia, and promised autonomy for Greece. It also allowed Russia to occupy Moldavia and Walachia until the Ottoman Empire had paid a large indemnity; those indemnities were later reduced. The treaty was signed on 14 September 1829 in Adrianople by Count Alexey Fyodorovich Orlov of Russia and Abdülkadir Bey of the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 《阿德里安堡条约》又称《埃迪尔内条约》，结束了1828—1829年的俄土战争。条款有利于俄国，使其获得多瑙河河口通行权和黑海沿岸新领土。条约开放达达尼尔海峡供所有商船通行，授予塞尔维亚自治，并承诺给予希腊自治。条约还允许俄国占领摩尔达维亚和瓦拉几亚，直到奥斯曼帝国支付大笔赔款；这些赔款后来有所减少。条约于1829年9月14日在阿德里安堡签署，签署方为俄国的阿列克谢·费奥多罗维奇·奥尔洛夫伯爵和奥斯曼帝国的阿卜杜勒卡迪尔贝伊。

en.s: The Russo-Turkish War of 1828–1829 resulted from the Greek War of Independence of 1821–1829; war broke out after the Ottoman Sultan Mahmud II closed the Dardanelles to Russian ships and in November 1827 revoked the 1826 Akkerman Convention in retaliation for the participation of the Imperial Russian Navy in the Battle of Navarino of October 1827. The Ottoman Empire had bloodily abolished its centuries-old regular army, the Janissary Corps, in 1826. A year later, Great Britain, France, and Russia jointly raided the Ottoman Navy at Navarino. When war broke out between the Ottomans and Russia in 1828, the Ottomans possessed neither a regular army nor a navy. After suffering several defeats, both in the Balkans and in the Caucasus, the Sultan decided to sue for peace, which resulted in the signing of the Treaty of Adrianople on 14 September 1829.

zh.s: 1828—1829年的俄土战争源于1821—1829年的希腊独立战争。奥斯曼苏丹马哈茂德二世关闭达达尼尔海峡，不许俄国船只通过，并于1827年11月撤销1826年《阿克曼公约》，以报复俄罗斯帝国海军参加1827年10月的纳瓦里诺海战。奥斯曼帝国曾于1826年血腥解散延续数百年的常备军耶尼切里军团。次年，英国、法国和俄国联手在纳瓦里诺袭击奥斯曼海军。1828年俄奥战争爆发时，奥斯曼帝国既没有常备军，也没有海军。在巴尔干和高加索地区接连战败后，苏丹决定求和，并于1829年9月14日签署《阿德里安堡条约》。

en.s: The Battle of South Mountain—known in several early Southern accounts as the Battle of Boonsboro Gap—was fought September 14, 1862, as part of the Maryland Campaign of the American Civil War. Three pitched battles were fought for possession of three South Mountain passes: Crampton's, Turner's, and Fox's Gaps. Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan, commanding the Union Army of the Potomac, needed to pass through these gaps in his pursuit of Confederate General Robert E. Lee's precariously divided Army of Northern Virginia. Although the delay bought at South Mountain would allow him to reunite his army and forestall defeat in detail, Lee considered termination of the Maryland Campaign at nightfall.

en.s: William McKinley (January 29, 1843 – September 14, 1901) was the 25th president of the United States, serving from 1897 until his assassination in 1901. McKinley successfully led the U.S. in the Spanish–American War and oversaw a period of American expansionism, with the annexations of Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Philippines, and American Samoa.

en.s: A federal election was held in Germany on 14 September 1930 to elect the fifth Reichstag of the Weimar Republic. en.s: The Siege of Santuario de Nuestra Señora de la Cabeza took place from 14 September 1936 to 1 May 1937 in Andújar, Jaén, during the Spanish Civil War. The Republican army surrounded around 1,200 rebel civil guards and falangists who supported Franco and forced them to surrender after a protracted offensive.

en.s: The 1936 Maine gubernatorial election took place on September 14, 1936. Incumbent Democratic Governor Louis J. Brann did not seek re-election, and instead ran for the United States Senate. en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Maine
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Maine was held on September 14, 1936. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Wallace White was re-elected to a second term over Governor Louis J. Brann. Although 1936 is typically seen as the end of Maine's status as a national bellwether, White's narrow victory in strongly Republican Maine may have been a portent of doom for Alf Landon's fall presidential campaign, in which he carried only Maine and nearby Vermont.

zh.s: 缅因州于1936年9月14日举行美国参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员华莱士·怀特击败州长路易斯·J·布兰，连任第二届。1936年通常被视为缅因州不再是全国风向标之年，但共和党势力强大的缅因州里怀特仅以微弱优势获胜，这或许预示着阿尔夫·兰登的总统竞选将遭遇惨败。兰登在大选中只赢得缅因州和邻近的佛蒙特州。

en.s: The Battle of Przemyśl took place between 11 and 14 September 1939, during the German Invasion of Poland. The Polish Army garrison of the former Austrian fortress of Przemyśl (see Przemyśl Fortress) managed to halt the advance of the Wehrmacht for three days. The city surrendered on 14 September.

en.s: The Battle of Boratycze took place on September 14, 1939, during the Invasion of Poland. Polish 24th Infantry Division, commanded by General Kazimierz Fabrycy, and supported by units of Border Protection Corps, clashed with German 2nd Mountain Division. The battle took place near the village of Boratycze, located between Przemysl and Lwów in the Second Polish Republic (now Lviv in Ukraine).

zh.s: 博拉蒂切战役于1939年9月14日波兰遭入侵期间爆发。卡齐米日·法布里齐将军指挥的波兰第24步兵师在边境防卫军部队支援下，与德国第2山地师交战。战场位于博拉蒂切村附近，在第二波兰共和国境内，介于普热梅希尔和利沃夫之间（利沃夫现属乌克兰）。

en.s: Battle of Gdynia was one of the major battles in northern Poland during the Invasion of Poland of 1939. The Germans' main push towards Gdynia began on 1 September and they captured Gdynia two weeks later on 14 September. After the fall of Gdynia, the warfare continued on the plateau called Kępa Oksywska.

en.s: The Ip massacre was the mass killing of around 150 ethnic Romanians by the Royal Hungarian Army on 14 September 1940, in Ipp, (today Ip, Sălaj County), Northern Transylvania, and in nearby locations and surrounding areas. After two Hungarian soldiers died in an accidental explosion in Ip, rumors spread that they had been killed by Romanians, and the killings were committed in response.

en.t: Sabotage at the General Post Office in Zagreb
en.s: Sabotage at the General Post Office in Zagreb took place during the Second World War on Sunday, 14 September 1941. Zagreb had been occupied by the Axis Ustaše, and the Communist Party of Croatia had organized an underground resistance. Two explosions rocked the General Post Office building, destroying telegram and telephone communications equipment. Nine security personnel were injured, one fatally.

zh.t: 萨格勒布总邮局遭破坏行动
zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，萨格勒布总邮局遭破坏行动发生于1941年9月14日星期日。当时萨格勒布被轴心国扶植的乌斯塔沙政权占领，克罗地亚共产党组织了地下抵抗运动。两次爆炸震撼了总邮局大楼，摧毁了电报和电话通信设备。九名安保人员受伤，其中一人伤重身亡。

en.s: The 1942 Maine gubernatorial election took place on September 14, 1942. en.s: Operation Bigamy a.k.a. Operation Snowdrop was a raid during the Second World War by the Special Air Service on 14 September 1942. The plan was to destroy the harbour and storage facilities at Benghazi and raid the airfield at Benina in Libya in coordination with the RAF as part of a deception plan for Operation Agreement, the much larger raid on Tobruk.

zh.s: 大婚行动又称“雪花莲行动”，是第二次世界大战期间英国特别空勤团于1942年9月14日实施的一次突袭。计划是在英国皇家空军配合下，摧毁利比亚班加西港口和储存设施，并突袭贝尼纳机场，以配合更大规模的“协定行动”佯攻托布鲁克。

en.s: Operation Agreement was a ground and amphibious operation carried out by British, Rhodesian and New Zealand forces on Axis-held Tobruk from 13 to 14 September 1942, during the Second World War. A Special Interrogation Group party, fluent in German, took part in missions behind enemy lines. Diversionary actions extended to Benghazi (Operation Bigamy), Jalo oasis (Operation Nicety) and Barce (Operation Caravan).

en.s: The Battle of Edson's Ridge, also known as the Battle of the Bloody Ridge, Battle of Raiders Ridge, and Battle of the Ridge, was a land battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II between the Imperial Japanese Army and Allied (mainly United States Marine Corps) ground forces. It took place from 12 to 14 September 1942, on Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands, and was the second of three separate major Japanese ground offensives during the Guadalcanal campaign.

zh.s: 埃德森岭战役也称血腥岭战役、突击队岭战役或山脊战役，是第二次世界大战太平洋战场上的一场陆战，交战双方为日本帝国陆军和盟军地面部队（主要是美国海军陆战队）。战斗于1942年9月12日至14日在所罗门群岛的瓜达尔卡纳尔岛上进行，是瓜达尔卡纳尔战役期间日军三次大规模地面攻势中的第二次。

en.s: Convoy ON 127 was a trade convoy of merchant ships during the second World War. en.s: China News Service (CNS; Chinese: 中国新闻社) is the second largest state news agency in the People's Republic of China, after Xinhua News Agency. en.s: The 1955 FA Charity Shield was the 33rd FA Charity Shield, the annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Football League and FA Cup competitions. It was contested between Chelsea, the reigning First Division champions, and Newcastle United, holders of the FA Cup. Chelsea won 3–0, thanks to second-half goals from Roy Bentley and Frank Blunstone, and an own goal from Alf McMichael.

zh.s: 1955年英格兰足总慈善盾杯是第33届慈善盾杯。这项年度足球赛由上赛季英格兰足球联赛和足总杯的冠军对阵。本届由卫冕英格兰顶级联赛冠军切尔西对阵足总杯冠军纽卡斯尔联。切尔西以3比0获胜，罗伊·本特利和弗兰克·布伦斯通在下半场进球，阿尔夫·麦克迈克尔还打入一记乌龙球。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Richmond on 14 September 1957. This was triggered by the sudden death of Country Party MP Larry Anthony. en.t: The Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) is founded
en.s: The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC OH-pek) is an intergovernmental cartel enabling the co-operation of leading oil-producing and oil-dependent countries in order to collectively influence the global oil market and maximize profit. It was founded on 14 September 1960 in Baghdad by the first five members: Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and Venezuela. The organization, which currently comprises 11 member countries, accounted for 38 percent of global oil production in 2022.

zh.t: 石油输出国组织（欧佩克）成立
zh.s: 石油输出国组织（简称欧佩克，OPEC）是一个政府间组织，促进主要产油国及依赖石油的国家合作，以共同影响全球石油市场并增加收益。1960年9月14日，首批五个成员国伊朗、伊拉克、科威特、沙特阿拉伯和委内瑞拉在巴格达成立该组织。欧佩克目前有11个成员国；2022年，其成员国合计占全球石油产量的38%。

en.s: The 1961 F-84 Thunderstreak incident, occurring on 14 September 1961, was an incident during the Cold War, in which two Republic F-84F Thunderstreak fighter-bombers of JaBoG 32 of the German Air Force (Luftwaffe) crossed into East German airspace because of a navigational error, before landing at Berlin Tegel Airport.

en.s: The Battle of Omal was the second battle in the Eritrean War of Independence, and took place on 14 September 1961. In the battle, Ethiopian police units attempted to avenge the defeat in the Battle of Adal, but after a fierce battle they retreated. The Battle of Omal was the first battle where the ELF lost a soldier, Mohammed Fayd.

zh.s: 奥马尔战役是厄立特里亚独立战争中的第二场战役，于1961年9月14日爆发。埃塞俄比亚警察部队试图为此前在阿达尔战役中的失利复仇，但激战后被迫撤退。厄立特里亚解放阵线在这场战斗中首次有战士阵亡，死者是穆罕默德·法伊德。

en.s: Campaign 139 (Vietnamese: Chiến dịch 139) was a major military offensive of the People's Army of Vietnam, launched against its Royalist enemies during the Laotian Civil War. Larger than previous invading forces, Campaign 139 was also a combined arms expedition containing tanks, artillery, engineers, and Dac Cong sappers. As such, it was a decided escalation in the war.

en.s: The 1971 Tampa mayoral election took place on September 14, 1971. Incumbent Mayor Dick A. Greco ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by former Mayor Nick Nuccio, whom he defeated in 1967. Greco defeated Nuccio in a landslide, winning 66 percent of the vote and avoiding the need for a runoff election. In the process, he became the first mayor of Tampa to be re-elected since 1955.

zh.s: 1971年坦帕市长选举于9月14日举行。现任市长迪克·A·格雷科竞选连任第二届，对手是前市长尼克·努乔；格雷科曾在1967年击败努乔。这次他以压倒性优势击败努乔，获得66%的选票，无需进入决选。他也因此成为自1955年以来首位成功连任的坦帕市长。

en.s: A general election was held between Saturday, 24 August and Saturday, 14 September 1974 for members of the 4th Parliament of Malaysia. Voting took place in all 154 parliamentary constituencies of Malaysia, each electing one Member of Parliament to the Dewan Rakyat, the dominant house of Parliament. State elections also took place in 360 state constituencies in 12 (out of 13, except Sabah) states of Malaysia on the same day. This result was a victory for Barisan Nasional (formerly the Alliance Party), which won 135 of the 154 seats. Voter turnout was 75.1%.

zh.s: 马来西亚于1974年8月24日至9月14日举行大选，选出第四届国会议员。马来西亚154个国会选区都举行投票，每个选区选出一名下议院议员。同日，马来西亚13个州中的12个州（沙巴除外）也在360个州选区举行州选举。国民阵线（前身为联盟党）获胜，赢得154个国会议席中的135席。投票率为75.1%。

en.s: The 3rd Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF) took place in Toronto, Ontario, Canada between September 14 and September 21, 1978. It showcased 85 films, the lowest number of films in the festival's history. In Praise of Older Women directed by George Kaczender was selected as the opening film. When the Ontario Film Review Board objected to a 40-second scene between Marilyn Lightstone and Tom Berenger, co-producer of the film Robert Lantos cut the scene for the theatrical run.

en.t: Afghan leader Nur Muhammad Taraki is assassinated upon the order of Hafizullah Amin, who becomes the new General Secretary of the People's Democratic Party
en.s: Nur Muhammad Taraki (Pashto: نور محمد ترکی‎; 14 July 1917 – 9 October 1979) was an Afghan communist politician, revolutionary, journalist and writer. He was a founding member of the People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan (PDPA) who served as its General Secretary from 1965 to 1979 and Chairman of the Revolutionary Council from 1978 to 1979. Taraki was born in Nawa, Ghazni Province.

zh.t: 阿富汗领导人努尔·穆罕默德·塔拉基遇刺，哈菲佐拉·阿明接任人民民主党总书记
zh.s: 努尔·穆罕默德·塔拉基（普什图语：نور محمد ترکی；1917年7月14日—1979年10月9日）是阿富汗共产主义政治人物、革命者、记者和作家。他是阿富汗人民民主党的创始成员之一，1965年至1979年担任总书记，1978年至1979年任革命委员会主席。他出生于加兹尼省纳瓦。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Norway on 13 and 14 September 1981. The Labour Party remained the largest party in the Storting, winning 66 of the 155 seats. The Conservative Party made the strongest gains and formed a government on its own. In 1983 a majority coalition government with the Christian People's Party and the Center Party was established.

zh.s: 挪威于1981年9月13日至14日举行议会选举。工党仍是议会第一大党，在155个席位中赢得66席。保守党增幅最大，并单独组建政府。1983年，保守党又与基督教人民党和中间党组成多数联合政府。

en.s: The September 1982 Errenteria attack was an ambush by the Basque separatist organisation ETA which occurred on 14 September 1982 on the motorway near the Basque town of Errenteria (Spanish: Rentería) in Gipuzkoa. The targets were several Spanish national police officers, four of whom were killed in the attack, with the fifth seriously injured. The attack was ETA's deadliest of 1982.

zh.s: 1982年9月14日，巴斯克分离主义组织埃塔在吉普斯夸省埃伦特里亚（西班牙语名：Rentería）附近的高速公路上伏击了西班牙国家警察。袭击造成4名警员死亡，另有1人重伤。这是埃塔在1982年造成死亡人数最多的一次袭击。

en.s: On 14 September 1982, a bomb was detonated during a meeting of the right-wing Kataeb Party (also known as the Phalanges) in the Beirut neighbourhood of Achrafieh. Militia commander and Lebanese president-elect Bashir Gemayel and 23 other Kataeb Party politicians were killed in the attack. The attack was carried out by Habib Shartouni and allegedly planned by Nabil Alam, both members of the Syrian Social Nationalist Party (SSNP).

zh.s: 1982年9月14日，右翼长枪党（又称长枪党）在贝鲁特阿什拉菲耶区举行会议期间发生炸弹爆炸。民兵指挥官、黎巴嫩总统当选人巴希尔·杰马耶勒及另外23名长枪党政客在袭击中丧生。袭击由哈比卜·沙尔图尼实施，据信由叙利亚社会民族党（SSNP）成员纳比勒·阿拉姆策划。

en.s: The E36 Penang Bridge is a 13.5-kilometre (8.4-mile) dual carriageway toll bridge and controlled-access highway in the Malaysian state of Penang. It connects Perai on the mainland side of the state with Gelugor on the island, crossing the Penang Strait. The bridge was the first and, until 2014, only road connection between the peninsula and the island.
en.n: Penang Bridge was inaugurated on 14 September 1985.

zh.s: E36槟城大桥是一座全长13.5公里（8.4英里）的收费双向高速公路，位于马来西亚槟城州。大桥横跨槟威海峡，连接槟城半岛一侧的北海与岛上的日落洞。它是半岛与槟城岛之间第一条公路连接线；直到2014年，这也是两地之间唯一的公路连接线。

en.s: The Standard Gravure shooting occurred on September 14, 1989, in Louisville, Kentucky, United States, when Joseph Thomas Wesbecker, a 47-year-old pressman, killed eight people and injured twelve at his former workplace, Standard Gravure, before committing suicide. The shooting is the deadliest incident of workplace violence in Kentucky's history as well as the deadliest mass shooting.

zh.t: 标准凹版印刷公司枪击案
zh.s: 1989年9月14日，美国肯塔基州路易维尔市发生标准凹版印刷公司枪击案。47岁的印刷工约瑟夫·托马斯·韦斯贝克尔在自己曾工作的标准凹版印刷公司开枪，造成8人死亡、12人受伤，随后自杀。这是肯塔基州史上最致命的职场暴力事件，也是该州伤亡最惨重的大规模枪击案。

en.s: The 1989 South African presidential election resulted in the election of Frederik Willem de Klerk as State President. After the South African Constitution of 1983 came into force in 1984, the State President had been both Head of State and Head of Government, but also, in the tradition of the Westminster system, the leader of the most important party represented in the House of Assembly of Parliament.

en.s: General elections were held in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 14 September 1996. The elections for the House of Representatives elections were divided into two; one for the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina and one for Republika Srpska. In the presidential election, each of the three national communities elected a President. Bosniaks elected Alija Izetbegović, Croats elected Krešimir Zubak and Serbs elected Momčilo Krajišnik. The Party of Democratic Action emerged as the largest party in the House of Representatives, winning 19 of the 42 seats. Voter turnout was 79.4% in the parliamentary election and 80.4% in the presidential election.

zh.s: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那于1996年9月14日举行大选。众议院选举分为波黑联邦和塞族共和国两个部分。总统选举中，三个民族共同体各自选出一名总统：波什尼亚克人选出阿利亚·伊泽特贝戈维奇，克罗地亚人选出克雷希米尔·祖巴克，塞尔维亚人选出姆姆奇洛·克拉伊什尼克。民主行动党成为众议院第一大党，在42个席位中赢得19席。议会选举投票率为79.4%，总统选举投票率为80.4%。

en.s: Windows Me (Millennium Edition) is an operating system developed by Microsoft as the last in the Windows 9x line of Microsoft Windows operating systems. It was the successor to Windows 98, and was released to manufacturing on June 19, 2000, and then to retail on September 14, 2000. It was Microsoft's main operating system for home users until the introduction of the NT-based Windows XP on October 25, 2001.

zh.s: Windows Me（Millennium Edition，千禧版）是微软开发的操作系统，也是微软Windows 9x系列的最后一个版本。它是Windows 98的后续版本，于2000年6月19日交付制造商，并于同年9月14日零售上市。2001年10月25日，基于NT架构的Windows XP推出，此前Windows Me一直是微软面向家庭用户的主力操作系统。

en.s: Since the introduction of parliamentarism in Sweden, six national referendums have been held. en.s: The 2009 parliamentary election was held in Norway on 13 and 14 September 2009. Elections in Norway are held on a Monday in September, usually the second or third Monday, as determined by the king. Early voting was possible between 10 August and 11 September 2009, while some municipalities also held open voting on 13 September. Voters elected 169 members for the Storting, each for a four-year term. Voter turn-out in the 2009 general elections was 76.4%. Candidates were elected on party lists in each of the 19 counties. The political parties nominated candidates for these lists during late 2008 and early 2009.

en.s: The CMLL 79th Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on September 14, 2012 in CMLL's home arena Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico. The event commemorated the 79th anniversary of CMLL, the oldest professional wrestling promotion in the world. The Anniversary show is normally CMLL's biggest show of the year, their Super Bowl event. The 79th Anniversary show was also billed as Juicio Final, or "Final Justice"/"Doomsday", a title that CMLL has used at times either as a tag line for the tag line for an Anniversary show or as the name of a separate super show produced by CMLL marketed as CMLL Juicio Final.

en.s: An election to the Landtag of Thuringia was held on 14 September 2014. The incumbent government was a CDU-SPD grand coalition led by Minister-President Christine Lieberknecht. After the election, the CDU-SPD coalition continued to have a majority in the Landtag, however only barely with just 46 seats or a majority of 1. en.s: General elections were held in Sweden on 14 September 2014 to elect the Riksdag, all 21 county councils and 290 municipal assemblies. The centre-right Alliance for Sweden coalition (comprising the Moderate Party, Liberal People's Party, Centre Party and Christian Democrats) sought a third term in government. In contrast to the previous election, the three largest left-wing parties (the Social Democrats, Green Party and Left Party) ran independent campaigns, as did the comparatively far-right Sweden Democrats. A fourth left-wing party, Feminist Initiative, did not secure the 4% threshold. The election result saw the three left-wing parties outpoll the Alliance for Sweden, with the two blocs respectively winning 159 and 141 seats.

en.s: Local elections were held in Norway on 14 September 2015. Voters elected representatives to municipal and county councils, which are responsible for education, public transport, health, and elderly care, and for the levy of certain taxes. The Labour Party became the largest party, gaining 33% of the vote, while the nationally governing Conservative and Progress parties suffered losses relative to their performances in the 2013 parliamentary and 2011 local elections. en.s: The Cruiserweight Classic, formerly the Global Cruiserweight Series, was a 2016 professional wrestling tournament and WWE Network event produced by WWE. The tournament was contested by wrestlers from WWE's developmental brand, NXT, and wrestlers from the independent and international circuits; all participants were billed at a weight of 205 lbs or less to determine the inaugural WWE Cruiserweight Champion for WWE's revived cruiserweight division. The winner was T. J. Perkins. The tournament consisted of various matches that had predetermined results. Tournament qualifying matches took place in various independent promotions, including well-known promotions such as Revolution Pro Wrestling, Progress Wrestling, and Evolve. Many cruiserweight wrestlers from around the world were given the chance to qualify for the 32-man tournament, which took place over four dates: June 23, July 13, August 26, and September 14, 2016.
